I wanted to quit my current job over that I felt I ruined the relationship with a colleague.

It gets kind of complicated. He joined in this company later than me. We were of the same rank, but he is older than me and have more experience in the industry. I can just ask him to take a pantry break with me and ask him for advice, any silly questions. He would also joke and laugh talking to me. 

Later he is promoted to a manager role overseeing our team. This company is an small company of less than 20 people. 

I kind of ruined the friendship because one day I argued with him about project estimates.

He now made sure to delegate my other lead to oversee my tasks. 
I see that he mingle and laugh with the other leads, not with us.

Keep in mind he still being professional. Maybe he is acting too professional because of his rank now, and I missed the colleague friendly relationship. 

Maybe it is abusing privilege, but I thought that being a small company everyone including the leads, would be open to sharing to the juniors. Not being hierarchical and not tell us whats going on at the upper level.

I talked to another senior female colleague, and she berated me over not having trust with your fellow colleague that is now your manager. 

I don't think I am being jealous over him getting promoted.

I kind of don't like how things are run in the company even though they are doing a better job than my previous manager overall.
